environment.description: Gmsh 是具有几何建模、二维及三维有限元网格生成和前后处理功能的开源工具，其 Python API 可构建几何实体、定义物理分组、设置网格尺寸、生成并查询节点和单元，以及读写网格文件。本次作为网格生成后端整理；用于 DEVSIM 时需匹配 MSH 格式及器件区域、接触和界面标签。

init_ref_tools.name: initialize
init_ref_tools.description: Initialize the Gmsh API. This must be called before any call to the other functions in the API. If `argc' and `argv' (or just `argv' in Python or Julia) are provided, they will be handled in the same way as the command line arguments in the Gmsh app. If `readConfigFiles' is set, read system Gmsh configuration files (gmshrc and gmsh-options). If `run' is set, run in the same way as the Gmsh app, either interactively or in batch mode depending on the command line arguments. If `run' is not set, initializing the API sets the options "General.AbortOnError" to 2 and "General.Terminal" to 1.
init_ref_tools.ori_input: argv = [], readConfigFiles = True, run = False, interruptible = True
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.initialize(argv=[], readConfigFiles=True, run=False)  Initialize the Gmsh API. This must be called before any call to the other functions in the API. If `argc' and `argv' (or just `argv' in Python or Julia) are provided, they will be handled in the same way as the command line arguments in the Gmsh app. If `readConfigFiles' is set, read system Gmsh configuration files (gmshrc and gmsh-options). If `run' is set, run in the same way as the Gmsh app, either interactively or in batch mode depending on the command line arguments. If `run' is not set, initializing the API sets the options "General.AbortOnError" to 2 and "General.Terminal" to 1.  Types: - `argv': command line arguments - `readConfigFiles': boolean - `run': boolean

init_ref_tools.name: isInitialized
init_ref_tools.description: Return 1 if the Gmsh API is initialized, and 0 if not.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.isInitialized()  Return 1 if the Gmsh API is initialized, and 0 if not.  Return an integer.

init_ref_tools.name: finalize
init_ref_tools.description: Finalize the Gmsh API. This must be called when you are done using the Gmsh API.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.finalize()  Finalize the Gmsh API. This must be called when you are done using the Gmsh API.

init_ref_tools.name: open
init_ref_tools.description: Open a file. Equivalent to the `File->Open' menu in the Gmsh app. Handling of the file depends on its extension and/or its contents: opening a file with model data will create a new model.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.open(fileName)  Open a file. Equivalent to the `File->Open' menu in the Gmsh app. Handling of the file depends on its extension and/or its contents: opening a file with model data will create a new model.  Types: - `fileName': string

init_ref_tools.name: merge
init_ref_tools.description: Merge a file. Equivalent to the `File->Merge' menu in the Gmsh app. Handling of the file depends on its extension and/or its contents. Merging a file with model data will add the data to the current model.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.merge(fileName)  Merge a file. Equivalent to the `File->Merge' menu in the Gmsh app. Handling of the file depends on its extension and/or its contents. Merging a file with model data will add the data to the current model.  Types: - `fileName': string

init_ref_tools.name: write
init_ref_tools.description: Write a file. The export format is determined by the file extension.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.write(fileName)  Write a file. The export format is determined by the file extension.  Types: - `fileName': string

init_ref_tools.name: clear
init_ref_tools.description: Clear all loaded models and post-processing data, and add a new empty model.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.clear()  Clear all loaded models and post-processing data, and add a new empty model.

init_ref_tools.name: setNumber
init_ref_tools.description: Set a numerical option to `value'. `name' is of the form "Category.Option" or "Category[num].Option". Available categories and options are listed in the "Gmsh options" chapter of the Gmsh reference manual (https://gmsh.info/doc/texinfo/gmsh.html#Gmsh-options).
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.option.setNumber(name, value)  Set a numerical option to `value'. `name' is of the form "Category.Option" or "Category[num].Option". Available categories and options are listed in the "Gmsh options" chapter of the Gmsh reference manual (https://gmsh.info/doc/texinfo/gmsh.html#Gmsh-options).  Types: - `name': string - `value': double

init_ref_tools.name: getNumber
init_ref_tools.description: Get the `value' of a numerical option. `name' is of the form "Category.Option" or "Category[num].Option". Available categories and options are listed in the "Gmsh options" chapter of the Gmsh reference manual (https://gmsh.info/doc/texinfo/gmsh.html#Gmsh-options).
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.option.getNumber(name)  Get the `value' of a numerical option. `name' is of the form "Category.Option" or "Category[num].Option". Available categories and options are listed in the "Gmsh options" chapter of the Gmsh reference manual (https://gmsh.info/doc/texinfo/gmsh.html#Gmsh-options).  Return `value'.  Types: - `name': string - `value': double

init_ref_tools.description: Add a new model, with name `name', and set it as the current model.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.add(name)  Add a new model, with name `name', and set it as the current model.  Types: - `name': string

init_ref_tools.name: remove
init_ref_tools.description: Remove the current model.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.remove()  Remove the current model.

init_ref_tools.name: list
init_ref_tools.description: List the names of all models.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.list()  List the names of all models.  Return `names'.  Types: - `names': vector of strings

init_ref_tools.name: getCurrent
init_ref_tools.description: Get the name of the current model.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.getCurrent()  Get the name of the current model.  Return `name'.  Types: - `name': string

init_ref_tools.name: setCurrent
init_ref_tools.description: Set the current model to the model with name `name'. If several models have the same name, select the one that was added first.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.setCurrent(name)  Set the current model to the model with name `name'. If several models have the same name, select the one that was added first.  Types: - `name': string

init_ref_tools.name: getEntities
init_ref_tools.description: Get all the entities in the current model. A model entity is represented by two integers: its dimension (dim == 0, 1, 2 or 3) and its tag (its unique, strictly positive identifier). If `dim' is >= 0, return only the entities of the specified dimension (e.g. points if `dim' == 0). The entities are returned as a vector of (dim, tag) pairs.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.getEntities(dim=-1)  Get all the entities in the current model. A model entity is represented by two integers: its dimension (dim == 0, 1, 2 or 3) and its tag (its unique, strictly positive identifier). If `dim' is >= 0, return only the entities of the specified dimension (e.g. points if `dim' == 0). The entities are returned as a vector of (dim, tag) pairs.  Return `dimTags'.  Types: - `dimTags': vector of pairs of integers - `dim': integer

init_ref_tools.name: getPhysicalGroups
init_ref_tools.description: Get the physical groups in the current model. The physical groups are returned as a vector of (dim, tag) pairs. If `dim' is >= 0, return only the groups of the specified dimension (e.g. physical points if `dim' == 0).
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.getPhysicalGroups(dim=-1)  Get the physical groups in the current model. The physical groups are returned as a vector of (dim, tag) pairs. If `dim' is >= 0, return only the groups of the specified dimension (e.g. physical points if `dim' == 0).  Return `dimTags'.  Types: - `dimTags': vector of pairs of integers - `dim': integer

init_ref_tools.name: addPhysicalGroup
init_ref_tools.description: Add a physical group of dimension `dim', grouping the model entities with tags `tags'. Return the tag of the physical group, equal to `tag' if `tag' is positive, or a new tag if `tag' < 0. Set the name of the physical group if `name' is not empty.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.addPhysicalGroup(dim, tags, tag=-1, name="")  Add a physical group of dimension `dim', grouping the model entities with tags `tags'. Return the tag of the physical group, equal to `tag' if `tag' is positive, or a new tag if `tag' < 0. Set the name of the physical group if `name' is not empty.  Return an integer.  Types: - `dim': integer - `tags': vector of integers - `tag': integer - `name': string

init_ref_tools.name: setPhysicalName
init_ref_tools.description: Set the name of the physical group of dimension `dim' and tag `tag'.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.setPhysicalName(dim, tag, name)  Set the name of the physical group of dimension `dim' and tag `tag'.  Types: - `dim': integer - `tag': integer - `name': string

init_ref_tools.name: getPhysicalName
init_ref_tools.description: Get the name of the physical group of dimension `dim' and tag `tag'.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.getPhysicalName(dim, tag)  Get the name of the physical group of dimension `dim' and tag `tag'.  Return `name'.  Types: - `dim': integer - `tag': integer - `name': string

init_ref_tools.name: getEntitiesForPhysicalGroup
init_ref_tools.description: Get the tags of the model entities making up the physical group of dimension `dim' and tag `tag'.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.getEntitiesForPhysicalGroup(dim, tag)  Get the tags of the model entities making up the physical group of dimension `dim' and tag `tag'.  Return `tags'.  Types: - `dim': integer - `tag': integer - `tags': vector of integers

init_ref_tools.name: getPhysicalGroupsForEntity
init_ref_tools.description: Get the tags of the physical groups (if any) to which the model entity of dimension `dim' and tag `tag' belongs.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.getPhysicalGroupsForEntity(dim, tag)  Get the tags of the physical groups (if any) to which the model entity of dimension `dim' and tag `tag' belongs.  Return `physicalTags'.  Types: - `dim': integer - `tag': integer - `physicalTags': vector of integers

init_ref_tools.name: getBoundary
init_ref_tools.description: Get the boundary of the model entities `dimTags', given as a vector of (dim, tag) pairs. Return in `outDimTags' the boundary of the individual entities (if `combined' is false) or the boundary of the combined geometrical shape formed by all input entities (if `combined' is true). Return tags multiplied by the sign of the boundary entity if `oriented' is true. Apply the boundary operator recursively down to dimension 0 (i.e. to points) if `recursive' is true.
init_ref_tools.ori_input: dimTags, combined = True, oriented = False, recursive = False
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.getBoundary(dimTags, combined=True, oriented=False, recursive=False)  Get the boundary of the model entities `dimTags', given as a vector of (dim, tag) pairs. Return in `outDimTags' the boundary of the individual entities (if `combined' is false) or the boundary of the combined geometrical shape formed by all input entities (if `combined' is true). Return tags multiplied by the sign of the boundary entity if `oriented' is true. Apply the boundary operator recursively down to dimension 0 (i.e. to points) if `recursive' is true.  Return `outDimTags'.  Types: - `dimTags': vector of pairs of integers - `outDimTags': vector of pairs of integers - `combined': boolean - `oriented': boolean - `recursive': boolean

init_ref_tools.name: getBoundingBox
init_ref_tools.description: Get the bounding box (`xmin', `ymin', `zmin'), (`xmax', `ymax', `zmax') of the model entity of dimension `dim' and tag `tag'. If `dim' and `tag' are negative, get the bounding box of the whole model.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.getBoundingBox(dim, tag)  Get the bounding box (`xmin', `ymin', `zmin'), (`xmax', `ymax', `zmax') of the model entity of dimension `dim' and tag `tag'. If `dim' and `tag' are negative, get the bounding box of the whole model.  Return `xmin', `ymin', `zmin', `xmax', `ymax', `zmax'.  Types: - `dim': integer - `tag': integer - `xmin': double - `ymin': double - `zmin': double - `xmax': double - `ymax': double - `zmax': double

init_ref_tools.name: getDimension
init_ref_tools.description: Return the geometrical dimension of the current model.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.getDimension()  Return the geometrical dimension of the current model.  Return an integer.

init_ref_tools.name: addPoint
init_ref_tools.description: Add a geometrical point in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation, at coordinates (`x', `y', `z'). If `meshSize' is > 0, add a meshing constraint at that point. If `tag' is positive, set the tag explicitly; otherwise a new tag is selected automatically. Return the tag of the point. (Note that the point will be added in the current model only after `synchronize' is called. This behavior holds for all the entities added in the occ module.)
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.occ.addPoint(x, y, z, meshSize=0., tag=-1)  Add a geometrical point in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation, at coordinates (`x', `y', `z'). If `meshSize' is > 0, add a meshing constraint at that point. If `tag' is positive, set the tag explicitly; otherwise a new tag is selected automatically. Return the tag of the point. (Note that the point will be added in the current model only after `synchronize' is called. This behavior holds for all the entities added in the occ module.)  Return an integer.  Types: - `x': double - `y': double - `z': double - `meshSize': double - `tag': integer

init_ref_tools.name: addLine
init_ref_tools.description: Add a straight line segment in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation, between the two points with tags `startTag' and `endTag'. If `tag' is positive, set the tag explicitly; otherwise a new tag is selected automatically. Return the tag of the line.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.occ.addLine(startTag, endTag, tag=-1)  Add a straight line segment in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation, between the two points with tags `startTag' and `endTag'. If `tag' is positive, set the tag explicitly; otherwise a new tag is selected automatically. Return the tag of the line.  Return an integer.  Types: - `startTag': integer - `endTag': integer - `tag': integer

init_ref_tools.name: addCurveLoop
init_ref_tools.description: Add a curve loop (a closed wire) in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation, formed by the curves `curveTags'. `curveTags' should contain tags of curves forming a closed loop. Negative tags can be specified for compatibility with the built-in kernel, but are simply ignored: the wire is oriented according to the orientation of its first curve. Note that an OpenCASCADE curve loop can be made of curves that share geometrically identical (but topologically different) points. If `tag' is positive, set the tag explicitly; otherwise a new tag is selected automatically. Return the tag of the curve loop.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.occ.addCurveLoop(curveTags, tag=-1)  Add a curve loop (a closed wire) in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation, formed by the curves `curveTags'. `curveTags' should contain tags of curves forming a closed loop. Negative tags can be specified for compatibility with the built-in kernel, but are simply ignored: the wire is oriented according to the orientation of its first curve. Note that an OpenCASCADE curve loop can be made of curves that share geometrically identical (but topologically different) points. If `tag' is positive, set the tag explicitly; otherwise a new tag is selected automatically. Return the tag of the curve loop.  Return an integer.  Types: - `curveTags': vector of integers - `tag': integer

init_ref_tools.name: addPlaneSurface
init_ref_tools.description: Add a plane surface in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation, defined by one or more curve loops (or closed wires) `wireTags'. The first curve loop defines the exterior contour; additional curve loop define holes. If `tag' is positive, set the tag explicitly; otherwise a new tag is selected automatically. Return the tag of the surface.
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.occ.addPlaneSurface(wireTags, tag=-1)  Add a plane surface in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation, defined by one or more curve loops (or closed wires) `wireTags'. The first curve loop defines the exterior contour; additional curve loop define holes. If `tag' is positive, set the tag explicitly; otherwise a new tag is selected automatically. Return the tag of the surface.  Return an integer.  Types: - `wireTags': vector of integers - `tag': integer

init_ref_tools.name: addRectangle
init_ref_tools.description: Add a rectangle in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation, with lower left corner at (`x', `y', `z') and upper right corner at (`x' + `dx', `y' + `dy', `z'). If `tag' is positive, set the tag explicitly; otherwise a new tag is selected automatically. Round the corners if `roundedRadius' is nonzero. Return the tag of the rectangle.
init_ref_tools.ori_input: x, y, z, dx, dy, tag = -1, roundedRadius = 0.0
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.occ.addRectangle(x, y, z, dx, dy, tag=-1, roundedRadius=0.)  Add a rectangle in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation, with lower left corner at (`x', `y', `z') and upper right corner at (`x' + `dx', `y' + `dy', `z'). If `tag' is positive, set the tag explicitly; otherwise a new tag is selected automatically. Round the corners if `roundedRadius' is nonzero. Return the tag of the rectangle.  Return an integer.  Types: - `x': double - `y': double - `z': double - `dx': double - `dy': double - `tag': integer - `roundedRadius': double

init_ref_tools.name: addDisk
init_ref_tools.description: Add a disk in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation, with center (`xc', `yc', `zc') and radius `rx' along the x-axis and `ry' along the y-axis (`rx' >= `ry'). If `tag' is positive, set the tag explicitly; otherwise a new tag is selected automatically. If a vector `zAxis' of size 3 is provided, use it as the normal to the disk (z-axis). If a vector `xAxis' of size 3 is provided in addition to `zAxis', use it to define the x-axis. Return the tag of the disk.
init_ref_tools.ori_input: xc, yc, zc, rx, ry, tag = -1, zAxis = [], xAxis = []
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.occ.addDisk(xc, yc, zc, rx, ry, tag=-1, zAxis=[], xAxis=[])  Add a disk in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation, with center (`xc', `yc', `zc') and radius `rx' along the x-axis and `ry' along the y-axis (`rx' >= `ry'). If `tag' is positive, set the tag explicitly; otherwise a new tag is selected automatically. If a vector `zAxis' of size 3 is provided, use it as the normal to the disk (z-axis). If a vector `xAxis' of size 3 is provided in addition to `zAxis', use it to define the x-axis. Return the tag of the disk.  Return an integer.  Types: - `xc': double - `yc': double - `zc': double - `rx': double - `ry': double - `tag': integer - `zAxis': vector of doubles - `xAxis': vector of doubles

init_ref_tools.name: addBox
init_ref_tools.description: Add a parallelepipedic box in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation, defined by a point (`x', `y', `z') and the extents along the x-, y- and z-axes. If `tag' is positive, set the tag explicitly; otherwise a new tag is selected automatically. Return the tag of the box.
init_ref_tools.ori_input: x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, tag = -1
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.occ.addBox(x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, tag=-1)  Add a parallelepipedic box in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation, defined by a point (`x', `y', `z') and the extents along the x-, y- and z-axes. If `tag' is positive, set the tag explicitly; otherwise a new tag is selected automatically. Return the tag of the box.  Return an integer.  Types: - `x': double - `y': double - `z': double - `dx': double - `dy': double - `dz': double - `tag': integer

init_ref_tools.name: addSphere
init_ref_tools.description: Add a sphere of center (`xc', `yc', `zc') and radius `r' in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation. The optional `angle1' and `angle2' arguments define the polar angle opening (from -Pi/2 to Pi/2). The optional `angle3' argument defines the azimuthal opening (from 0 to 2*Pi). If `tag' is positive, set the tag explicitly; otherwise a new tag is selected automatically. Return the tag of the sphere.
init_ref_tools.ori_input: xc, yc, zc, radius, tag = -1, angle1 = -pi / 2, angle2 = pi / 2, angle3 = 2 * pi
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.occ.addSphere(xc, yc, zc, radius, tag=-1, angle1=-pi/2, angle2=pi/2, angle3=2*pi)  Add a sphere of center (`xc', `yc', `zc') and radius `r' in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation. The optional `angle1' and `angle2' arguments define the polar angle opening (from -Pi/2 to Pi/2). The optional `angle3' argument defines the azimuthal opening (from 0 to 2*Pi). If `tag' is positive, set the tag explicitly; otherwise a new tag is selected automatically. Return the tag of the sphere.  Return an integer.  Types: - `xc': double - `yc': double - `zc': double - `radius': double - `tag': integer - `angle1': double - `angle2': double - `angle3': double

init_ref_tools.name: addCylinder
init_ref_tools.description: Add a cylinder in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation, defined by the center (`x', `y', `z') of its first circular face, the 3 components (`dx', `dy', `dz') of the vector defining its axis and its radius `r'. The optional `angle' argument defines the angular opening (from 0 to 2*Pi). If `tag' is positive, set the tag explicitly; otherwise a new tag is selected automatically. Return the tag of the cylinder.
init_ref_tools.ori_input: x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, r, tag = -1, angle = 2 * pi
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.occ.addCylinder(x, y, z, dx, dy, dz, r, tag=-1, angle=2*pi)  Add a cylinder in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation, defined by the center (`x', `y', `z') of its first circular face, the 3 components (`dx', `dy', `dz') of the vector defining its axis and its radius `r'. The optional `angle' argument defines the angular opening (from 0 to 2*Pi). If `tag' is positive, set the tag explicitly; otherwise a new tag is selected automatically. Return the tag of the cylinder.  Return an integer.  Types: - `x': double - `y': double - `z': double - `dx': double - `dy': double - `dz': double - `r': double - `tag': integer - `angle': double

init_ref_tools.name: extrude
init_ref_tools.description: Extrude the entities `dimTags' (given as a vector of (dim, tag) pairs) in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation, using a translation along (`dx', `dy', `dz'). Return extruded entities in `outDimTags'. If the `numElements' vector is not empty, also extrude the mesh: the entries in `numElements' give the number of elements in each layer. If the `height' vector is not empty, it provides the (cumulative) height of the different layers, normalized to 1. If `recombine' is set, recombine the mesh in the layers.
init_ref_tools.ori_input: dimTags, dx, dy, dz, numElements = [], heights = [], recombine = False
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.occ.extrude(dimTags, dx, dy, dz, numElements=[], heights=[], recombine=False)  Extrude the entities `dimTags' (given as a vector of (dim, tag) pairs) in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation, using a translation along (`dx', `dy', `dz'). Return extruded entities in `outDimTags'. If the `numElements' vector is not empty, also extrude the mesh: the entries in `numElements' give the number of elements in each layer. If the `height' vector is not empty, it provides the (cumulative) height of the different layers, normalized to 1. If `recombine' is set, recombine the mesh in the layers.  Return `outDimTags'.  Types: - `dimTags': vector of pairs of integers - `dx': double - `dy': double - `dz': double - `outDimTags': vector of pairs of integers - `numElements': vector of integers - `heights': vector of doubles - `recombine': boolean

init_ref_tools.name: fuse
init_ref_tools.description: Compute the boolean union (the fusion) of the entities `objectDimTags' and `toolDimTags' (vectors of (dim, tag) pairs) in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation. Return the resulting entities in `outDimTags', and the correspondance between input and resulting entities in `outDimTagsMap'. If `tag' is positive, try to set the tag explicitly (only valid if the boolean operation results in a single entity). Remove the object if `removeObject' is set. Remove the tool if `removeTool' is set.

outDimTagsMap.type: vector of vectors of pairs of integers

init_ref_tools.ori_input: objectDimTags, toolDimTags, tag = -1, removeObject = True, removeTool = True
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.occ.fuse(objectDimTags, toolDimTags, tag=-1, removeObject=True, removeTool=True)  Compute the boolean union (the fusion) of the entities `objectDimTags' and `toolDimTags' (vectors of (dim, tag) pairs) in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation. Return the resulting entities in `outDimTags', and the correspondance between input and resulting entities in `outDimTagsMap'. If `tag' is positive, try to set the tag explicitly (only valid if the boolean operation results in a single entity). Remove the object if `removeObject' is set. Remove the tool if `removeTool' is set.  Return `outDimTags', `outDimTagsMap'.  Types: - `objectDimTags': vector of pairs of integers - `toolDimTags': vector of pairs of integers - `outDimTags': vector of pairs of integers - `outDimTagsMap': vector of vectors of pairs of integers - `tag': integer - `removeObject': boolean - `removeTool': boolean

init_ref_tools.name: cut
init_ref_tools.description: Compute the boolean difference between the entities `objectDimTags' and `toolDimTags' (given as vectors of (dim, tag) pairs) in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation. Return the resulting entities in `outDimTags', and the correspondance between input and resulting entities in `outDimTagsMap'. If `tag' is positive, try to set the tag explicitly (only valid if the boolean operation results in a single entity). Remove the object if `removeObject' is set. Remove the tool if `removeTool' is set.

outDimTagsMap.type: vector of vectors of pairs of integers

init_ref_tools.ori_input: objectDimTags, toolDimTags, tag = -1, removeObject = True, removeTool = True
init_ref_tools.ori_description: gmsh.model.occ.cut(objectDimTags, toolDimTags, tag=-1, removeObject=True, removeTool=True)  Compute the boolean difference between the entities `objectDimTags' and `toolDimTags' (given as vectors of (dim, tag) pairs) in the OpenCASCADE CAD representation. Return the resulting entities in `outDimTags', and the correspondance between input and resulting entities in `outDimTagsMap'. If `tag' is positive, try to set the tag explicitly (only valid if the boolean operation results in a single entity). Remove the object if `removeObject' is set. Remove the tool if `removeTool' is set.  Return `outDimTags', `outDimTagsMap'.  Types: - `objectDimTags': vector of pairs of integers - `toolDimTags': vector of pairs of integers - `outDimTags': vector of pairs of integers - `outDimTagsMap': vector of vectors of pairs of integers - `tag': integer - `removeObject': boolean - `removeTool': boolean

init_ref_tools.name: intersect

source_metadata.selection_rule: Official gmsh.info stable release announcement, CHANGELOG.txt, PyPI version and exact GitLab release tag agree; not a GitHub project.

python_source_extraction.selection: public module classes/functions; __init__ and public source-defined class methods (including properties)
python_source_extraction.excluded: private definitions, non-constructor magic methods, imported/inherited APIs, nested definitions, external dependencies; tests/examples outside package directories

docstring_mapping.description: summary before Google/NumPy sections or reStructuredText fields
docstring_mapping.input: signature parameters; annotation types with docstring fallback; Google/NumPy/reStructuredText parameter descriptions
docstring_mapping.output: Returns/Yields or reStructuredText return/rtype; null if undocumented
docstring_mapping.ori_input: AST-rendered parameters, or DEVSIM native documented signature parameters
docstring_mapping.ori_description: complete normalized source docstring or native embedded documentation

python_source_extraction.missing_values: Undocumented text is an empty string; missing return sections and self/cls entries are null; missing lists are empty
python_source_extraction.namespace_policy: Gmsh staticmethod containers are API namespaces, recursively flattened as gmsh.model.mesh etc.; not instantiable tool classes. Snake-case aliases are excluded.
python_source_extraction.docstring_adapter: Generated Types fields supply types; Return fields supply named outputs; undocumented parameter/output descriptions stay empty.

python_api_selection.boundary: 无界面的几何构建、物理分组、网格尺寸场、生成、节点/单元查询与保存。优先 OCC 内核，补充基本 geo 线面入口；排除 GUI、ONELAB、插件与底层有限元基函数接口。静态命名空间按函数计数。
